user_rule_verbatim: 只有论文要正式声称'系统按预测收益与成本决定是否交换'时才实现 K_plan·q̂ > Ĉ + margin 并加匹配的开启/关闭比较；规划周期、预测器和余量只能用 calibration 确定。如果还没实现，先完成理论验证和 W/D、规划器消融，正文如实描述当前经验阈值；不把新门控默认塞进所有实验。
rationale: The predictive gate K_plan*q_hat > C_hat + margin is NOT implemented in the controller (neither v3-locked nor the E-A/E-P decoupled code).
The paper will NOT claim 'the system decides whether to swap by predicted benefit vs cost'; therefore per the frozen user rule the gate is not implemented and not added to any experiment.

Per the same rule the ordering is: finish theory validation (E-T, done), W/D ablation (E-A, grid running), planner ablation (E-P, offline done + P11 arm in campaign) BEFORE any gating work; gating stays out of the five-arm campaign so the campaign changes no additional factor.

E-T evidence is directly relevant context: q_hat (workload lower bound gains) UNDERestimated observed gains by 2-11% on real captured forwards, i.e. the benefit side of any future gate is measurable but currently biased; introducing a margin-calibrated gate would require new calibration runs and is deferred to future work.
paper_text_obligation: 正文如实描述当前经验阈值 (main text must honestly describe the current empirical thresholds):

current_empirical_gates_in_controller.threshold_ratio: 1.02 (a layer is a planning candidate only if worst-rank load / avg > 1.02; hot-rank loop breaks below it)
current_empirical_gates_in_controller.acceptance_margin: plan accepted only if simulated new_ratio < ratio - 0.0005 (per-plan first/best improvement rule)
current_empirical_gates_in_controller.min_swap_ops: 8 (plans with fewer ops are skipped as not worth a migration round)
current_empirical_gates_in_controller.defer_rule: re-plan deferred while improvement < 0.003 (empirical hysteresis, not a cost model)
current_empirical_gates_in_controller.budgets: max_total_ops=300, max_swaps_per_layer=64, max_total_swap_layers=94 (action budgets, not benefit-cost gates)
current_empirical_gates_in_controller.dead_zone_ratio: 0.0 -> auto 1.096 by EP power law (identical across all arms, C6)

what_would_be_required_if_claim_changes: implement K_plan*q_hat > C_hat + margin with calibration-determined planning period K_plan, benefit predictor q_hat, cost predictor C_hat and margin; add matched gate-on/gate-off comparison arms; none of this is in scope of the frozen five-arm campaign.
